notes: «قال وسمعت أخاه أبا بكر» continues from Ibn Jurayj, so the second route keeps the head إبراهيم > هشام > ابن جريج (the Example 3 pattern) (rule 3)
«أخاه أبا بكر بن أبي مليكة» is one link: the brother is written before the name, so the surface is the name alone (rule 7)
the saying is Ibn Abbas's answer to Umar; the first route ends at Ibn Abbas, the second at Umar, who speaks the words; the parable of the rich man is inside Umar's words, not a link
